- **Foundry loss trend:** Intel Foundry operating loss widened from $(5,169)M (2022) to $(6,955)M (2023) [REC-INTC-01-01, REC-INTC-01-02], while external foundry revenue grew ($474M → $953M) [REC-INTC-01-03] — loss widening despite external revenue growth.
